question_mn: Одоогийн байдлаар идэвхтэй төлөвтэй байгууллага харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Odoogiin baidlaar idewhtei tuluwtei baiguullaga hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: As of today, how many organization customers have active status?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_organizations FROM t2s.customers WHERE party_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND status_code = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: Энэ онд шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Ene ond shineer burtguulsen khariltsagch khed ve?
question_en: How many new customers have been onboarded this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: PEP гэж тэмдэглэгдсэн харилцагчдаас өндөр эсвэл маш өндөр эрсдэлийн түвшинтэй нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: PEP gej temdeglegdsen hariltsagchdaas undur eswel mash undur ersdeliin tvwshintei ni hed we?
question_en: Among customers flagged as PEP, how many have a high or critical risk level?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pep_high_risk FROM t2s.customers WHERE is_pep AND risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')

question_mn: KYC-ийн хугацаа нь дууссан хэрнээ идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: KYC-iin khugatsaa ni duussan khernee idevkhtei tolovtei khariltsagch khed baina?
question_en: How many customers have an expired KYC but still have active status?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE kyc_status = 'EXPIRED' AND status_code = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: Боловсролын түвшин нь бүртгэгдээгүй хувь хүн харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Bolowsroliin tvwshin ni bvrtgegdeegvi huwi hvn hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many individual customers have no education level recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.individuals WHERE education_level IS NULL

question_mn: Харилцагч болоод 5-аас дээш жил болж байгаа идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Hariltsagch bolood 5-aas deesh jil bolj baigaa idewhtei tuluwtei hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many active-status customers have been with us for more than 5 years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND onboarded_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years'

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрээр шинээр бүртгүүлсэн хувь хүн болон байгууллага харилцагчийн тоог тус тусад нь гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bureer shineer burtguulsen khuvi khun bolon baiguullaga khariltsagchiin toog tus tusad ni garga
question_en: For each quarter of 2025, show the number of newly onboarded individual and organization customers separately.
question_mixed: 2025 оны quarter бүрээр шинэ individual болон organization клиентийн тоог тусад нь гарга
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM onboarded_date)::int AS quarter, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL') AS new_individuals, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE party_type = 'ORGANIZATION') AS new_organizations FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн нийт харилцагчийн хэдэн хувь нь идэвхтэй төлөвтэй байгааг салбарын нэрээр гарга
question_latin: Salbar bvriin niit hariltsagchiin heden huwi ni idewhtei tuluwtei baigaag salbariin nereer garga
question_en: For each branch, what percentage of its customers have active status? Show it by branch name.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE') / COUNT(*), 2) AS active_pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн багцад зээлтэй харилцагч хэд байгааг гарга
question_latin: Segment bureer idevkhtei zeeliin bagtsad zeeltei khariltsagch khed baigaag garga
question_en: By customer segment, how many customers have a loan in the active portfolio?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS borrowers FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.segment_name
notes: Нэг харилцагч олон зээлтэй байж болох тул COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id).

question_mn: ЖДҮ харилцагчдыг үйл ажиллагааны чиглэлээр нь тоолж, чиглэл бүрийн дундаж жилийн борлуулалтын орлогыг гарга
question_latin: JDV hariltsagchdiig vil ajillagaanii chigleleer ni toolj, chiglel bvriin dundaj jiliin borluulaltiin orlogiig garga
question_en: Count the SME customers by industry sector and show the average annual revenue of each sector.
gold_sql: SELECT o.industry_sector, COUNT(*) AS sme_count, ROUND(AVG(o.annual_revenue), 2) AS avg_annual_revenue FROM t2s.organizations o JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'ORG_SME' GROUP BY o.industry_sector

question_mn: Хувь хүн зээлдэгчдийг насаар нь 25 хүртэл, 25–34, 35–44, 45–54, 55 ба түүнээс дээш гэж бүлэглээд бүлэг бүрийн идэвхтэй зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: Huwi hvn zeeldegchdiig nasaar ni 25 hvrtel, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55 ba tvvnees deesh gej bvlegleed bvleg bvriin idewhtei zeeliin bagtsiin vndsen vldegdliig garga
question_en: Group individual borrowers by age into under 25, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54 and 55+, and show the active portfolio principal outstanding of each group.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.age < 25 THEN '25 хүртэл' WHEN i.age < 35 THEN '25-34' WHEN i.age < 45 THEN '35-44' WHEN i.age < 55 THEN '45-54' ELSE '55+' END AS age_group, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Харилцагчийн төрөл бүрээр өндөр болон маш өндөр эрсдэлийн түвшинтэй харилцагчдын эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: Khariltsagchiin torol bureer ondor bolon mash ondor ersdeliin tuvshintei khariltsagchdiin ezlekh khuviig garga
question_en: For each customer type, show the share of customers with a high or critical risk level.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_type_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_pct FROM t2s.customers GROUP BY customer_type_name

question_mn: Үндсэн хаяг нь харьяалах салбарынхаа аймаг, хотоос өөр газар байгаа харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Vndsen hayag ni hariyaalah salbariinhaa aimag, hotoos uur gazar baigaa hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many customers have a primary address in a different province or city than their home branch?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.province <> b.province
notes: Харилцагчийн province (хаяг) ба салбарын province-ийг харьцуулна.

question_mn: Салбар бүрт одоо ажиллаж байгаа зээлийн мэргэжилтэн хэд байгааг гарга
question_latin: Salbar burt odoo ajillaj baigaa zeeliin mergejilten khed baigaag garga
question_en: How many credit officers are currently working in each branch?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS credit_officers FROM t2s.employees e JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = e.branch_id WHERE e.position_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER' AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Одоо ажиллаж байгаа = employment_status 'ACTIVE' (чөлөөтэй, гарсан орохгүй).

question_mn: Хуулийн этгээдийн хэлбэр бүрээр байгууллага харилцагчид дунджаар хэдэн жил үйл ажиллагаа явуулж байгааг гарга
question_latin: Huuliin etgeediin helber bvreer baiguullaga hariltsagchid dundjaar heden jil vil ajillagaa yawuulj baigaag garga
question_en: By legal form, how many years on average have the organization customers been in business?
gold_sql: SELECT legal_form, ROUND(AVG((CURRENT_DATE - establishment_date) / 365.25), 2) AS avg_years_in_business FROM t2s.organizations GROUP BY legal_form
notes: Үүсгэн байгуулагдсанаас өнөөдөр (2026-06-30) хүртэлх хоногийг 365.25-д хувааж жил болгоно.

question_mn: 90-ээс олон харилцагчтай мэргэжлүүдээс дундаж сарын орлогоороо тэргүүлэх 3 мэргэжил, дундаж орлогыг гарга
question_latin: 90-ees olon khariltsagchtai mergejluudees dundaj sariin orlogooroo terguulekh 3 mergejil, dundaj orlogiig garga
question_en: Among occupations with more than 90 customers, list the top 3 by average monthly income together with the average income.
gold_sql: SELECT occupation, ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 2) AS avg_income FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY occupation HAVING COUNT(*) > 90 ORDER BY avg_income DESC, occupation LIMIT 3

question_mn: PEP харилцагчдын идэвхтэй зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: PEP khariltsagchdiin idevkhtei zeeliin bagtsiin undsen uldegdel niit khed ve?
question_en: What is the total active-portfolio principal outstanding of PEP customers?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE c.is_pep AND l.is_active_portfolio
notes: USD зээл орсон тул principal_outstanding_mnt-ийг нэмнэ.

question_mn: Хамгийн олон шууд харьяа (одоо ажиллаж буй) ажилтантай 3 удирдлагын нэр, харьяа ажилтны тоог гарга
question_latin: Hamgiin olon shuud hariyaa (odoo ajillaj bui) ajiltantai 3 udirdlagiin ner, hariyaa ajiltnii toog garga
question_en: List the 3 managers with the most direct reports who are currently employed, with the number of those reports.
gold_sql: SELECT m.full_name, COUNT(*) AS direct_reports FROM t2s.employees e JOIN t2s.employees m ON m.employee_id = e.manager_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY m.employee_id, m.full_name ORDER BY direct_reports DESC, m.employee_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: 2024 оноос хойш жил бүр шинээр бүртгүүлсэн хувь хүн харилцагчдын өнөөдрийн байдлаарх дундаж насыг гарга
question_latin: 2024 onoos hoish jil bvr shineer bvrtgvvlsen huwi hvn hariltsagchdiin unuudriin baidlaarh dundaj nasiig garga
question_en: For each year since 2024, show the current average age of the individual customers onboarded in that year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.onboarded_date)::int AS year, ROUND(AVG(i.age), 2) AS avg_age FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.onboarded_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Орон нутгийн салбаруудад харьяалагддаг харилцагчид нийт харилцагчийн хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байна?
question_latin: Oron nutgiin salbaruudad khariyaalagddag khariltsagchid niit khariltsagchiin kheden khuviig ezelj baina?
question_en: What percentage of all customers belong to branches outside Ulaanbaatar?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.province <> 'Улаанбаатар') / COUNT(*), 2) AS rural_pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id
notes: Орон нутаг = харьяа салбарын province <> 'Улаанбаатар' (харилцагчийн хаягаар биш).

question_mn: Байгууллага зээлдэгчдийн үйл ажиллагааны чиглэл бүрээр идэвхтэй багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Baiguullaga zeeldegchdiin vil ajillagaanii chiglel bvreer idewhtei bagtsiin vndsen vldegdel bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: For organization borrowers, show the active portfolio principal outstanding and PAR30 by industry sector.
question_mixed: Байгууллага borrower-уудын industry sector бүрээр active portfolio-ийн outstanding болон PAR30-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT o.industry_sector, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.organizations o ON o.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY o.industry_sector

question_mn: 2025 оны сар бүр шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчийн тоо болон тухайн сарын эцэс гэхэд нийт бүртгэгдсэн харилцагчийн хуримтлагдсан тоог гарга (хаагдсан харилцагчийг ч тооцно)
question_latin: 2025 onii sar bur shineer burtguulsen khariltsagchiin too bolon tukhain sariin etses gekhed niit burtgegdsen khariltsagchiin khurimtlagdsan toog garga (khaagdsan khariltsagchiig ch tootsno)
question_en: For each month of 2025, show the number of newly onboarded customers and the cumulative number of customers registered by the end of that month (including closed ones).
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', onboarded_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT month, new_customers, SUM(new_customers) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS total_customers FROM m) SELECT month, new_customers, total_customers FROM c WHERE month >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY month
notes: Хуримтлагдсан тоонд 2025 оноос өмнөх бүх харилцагч орно (2016 оноос) — шүүлтийг window-ийн дараа хийнэ.

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр энэ оны эхний хагаст шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчийн тоог өнгөрсөн оны мөн үетэй харьцуулж, өсөлтийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: Segment bvreer ene onii ehnii hagast shineer bvrtgvvlsen hariltsagchiin toog ungursun onii mun vetei haritsuulj, usultiin huwiig garga
question_en: By segment, compare the number of customers onboarded in the first half of this year with the same period last year and show the growth rate.
gold_sql: WITH n AS (SELECT segment_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS h1_2025, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS h1_2026 FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' OR onboarded_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY segment_name) SELECT segment_name, h1_2025, h1_2026, ROUND(100.0 * (h1_2026 - h1_2025) / NULLIF(h1_2025, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM n
notes: Энэ оны эхний хагас = 2026-01-01..2026-06-30; өнгөрсөн оны мөн үе = 2025-01-01..2025-06-30; өмнөх үе 0 бол өсөлт NULL (NULLIF).

question_mn: Идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь идэвхтэй зээл ч, идэвхтэй хадгаламж ч байхгүй вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei tolovtei khariltsagchdiin kheden khuvi ni idevkhtei zeel ch, idevkhtei khadgalamj ch baikhgui ve?
question_en: What percentage of active-status customers have neither a loan in the active portfolio nor an active deposit?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS no_product_pct FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
notes: Идэвхтэй зээл = is_active_portfolio; идэвхтэй хадгаламж = status 'ACTIVE'; NOT EXISTS хоёрыг хослуулна.

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй, мөн идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай (хоёулаа) харилцагч хэд байгааг гарга
question_latin: Segment bureer idevkhtei bagtsad zeeltei, mon idevkhtei khadgalamjtai (khoyulaa) khariltsagch khed baigaag garga
question_en: By segment, how many customers have both a loan in the active portfolio and an active deposit?
question_mixed: Segment бүрээр active loan болон active deposit хоёулаа байгаа клиентийн тоог гарга (cross-sell)
gold_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio), d AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT c.segment_name, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN l ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN d ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name
notes: Давхардлаас сэргийлж зээлдэгч, хадгаламж эзэмшигчийн давхардаагүй жагсаалтыг CTE-д гаргаад нийлүүлнэ.

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцын үндсэн үлдэгдлээр хамгийн том 10 зээлдэгч нийт багцын хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsiin vndsen vldegdleer hamgiin tom 10 zeeldegch niit bagtsiin heden huwiig ezelj baina?
question_en: What share of the total active portfolio (principal outstanding) is held by the 10 largest borrowers?
question_mixed: Top 10 borrower нийт loan portfolio-ийн хэдэн %-ийг эзэлж байна (concentration)?
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY customer_id), t AS (SELECT outstanding FROM b ORDER BY outstanding DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(outstanding) FROM t) / SUM(outstanding), 2) AS top10_share_pct FROM b
notes: Зээлдэгчээр (customer_id) нэгтгэсний дараа эрэмбэлнэ; 10 ба 11-р зээлдэгчийн дүн тэнцүү биш.

question_mn: Зээлийн хүсэлт гаргаж байсан ч нэг ч удаа зээл олгогдоогүй идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Zeeliin hvselt gargaj baisan ch neg ch udaa zeel olgogdoogvi idewhtei tuluwtei hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many active-status customers have submitted a loan application but have never been disbursed a loan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_applications a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL)
notes: Олголт хүлээж буй (disbursement_date NULL) зээлтэй харилцагч 'зээл олгогдоогүй'-д тооцогдоно.

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр ЖДҮ зээлдэгчдийн тоо, тэдний идэвхтэй багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Salbar bureer JDU zeeldegchdiin too, tednii idevkhtei bagtsiin undsen uldegdel bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: By branch, show the number of SME borrowers, their active portfolio principal outstanding and their PAR30.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS sme_borrowers, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND c.customer_type_code = 'ORG_SME' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Салбар = зээл олгосон салбар (loans.branch_id); ЖДҮ = customer_type_code 'ORG_SME'.

question_mn: 2025 онд бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь бүртгүүлснээсээ хойш 90 хоногийн дотор зээл авсныг бүртгүүлсэн улирал бүрээр гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond burtguulsen khariltsagchdiin kheden khuvi ni burtguulsneesee khoish 90 khonogiin dotor zeel avsniig burtguulsen uliral bureer garga
question_en: Of the customers onboarded in 2025, what percentage took a loan within 90 days of onboarding? Show it by onboarding quarter.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM c.onboarded_date)::int AS quarter, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.disbursement_date BETWEEN c.onboarded_date AND c.onboarded_date + 90)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS converted_pct FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.onboarded_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Сегмент бүрт идэвхтэй багцын үндсэн үлдэгдлээрээ хамгийн том зээлдэгчийн харилцагчийн дугаар болон үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: Segment burt idevkhtei bagtsiin undsen uldegdleeree khamgiin tom zeeldegchiin khariltsagchiin dugaar bolon uldegdliig garga
question_en: For each segment, show the customer number and principal outstanding of the largest borrower by active portfolio principal outstanding.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.segment_name, c.customer_id, c.customer_number, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.segment_name, c.customer_id, c.customer_number), r AS (SELECT segment_name, customer_number, outstanding, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_name ORDER BY outstanding DESC, customer_id) AS rn FROM s) SELECT segment_name, customer_number, outstanding FROM r WHERE rn = 1
notes: Харилцагчийн нэр хувийн мэдээлэл тул дугаарыг (customer_number) гаргана; зээлдэгчээр нэгтгээд сегмент дотор ROW_NUMBER.
